deadlines.appliesTo: Companies registered under the Companies Act No. 07 of 2007
deadlines.indicativeTiming: Generally due annually, with the filing window commonly linked to the company's AGM or financial year end
deadlines.notes: Exact timing depends on your company's financial year end and AGM date — confirm with us or the Registrar of Companies.

deadlines.indicativeTiming: Monthly, typically within the first half of the following month
deadlines.notes: Late payment can attract surcharges — confirm the exact due date for your business.

deadlines.indicativeTiming: Monthly, typically alongside the EPF contribution
deadlines.notes: Confirm the exact due date applicable to your business.

deadlines.obligation: APIT (Advance Personal Income Tax) deduction and remittance
deadlines.appliesTo: Employers deducting APIT from employee remuneration
deadlines.notes: Applicability depends on employee remuneration levels and current Inland Revenue guidance.

deadlines.indicativeTiming: Periodic — commonly monthly or quarterly depending on your VAT registration category
deadlines.notes: Filing frequency and due dates are set by the Inland Revenue Department and vary by taxpayer category.

deadlines.indicativeTiming: Quarterly instalments during the tax year
deadlines.notes: Instalment amounts and due dates depend on estimated tax liability for the year.

deadlines.indicativeTiming: Annually, following the end of the tax year (1 April – 31 March)
deadlines.notes: Confirm the current filing deadline for your entity type with the Inland Revenue Department.

deadlines.obligation: Renewal of trade/business licences and sector permits
deadlines.appliesTo: Businesses holding local authority or sector-specific licences
deadlines.indicativeTiming: Typically annual — exact timing varies by local authority and licence type
deadlines.notes: Requirements vary by municipality/local authority and by regulated sector.
